title: The 50-year-old amateur footballer who became a viral inspiration
summary: Craig Kirby, 50, initially considered retiring from amateur football after his son's death but instead went viral documenting his final season. His unexpected rise to social media prominence has made him an inspiration to fans worldwide.
content: Craig Kirby thought about quitting football following the death of his son - at 50, he didn't expect to go viral documenting his final season.

zh.title: 成为病毒式灵感的50岁业余足球运动员
zh.summary: 50岁的克雷格·柯比最初考虑在儿子去世后从业余足球中退役，但他反而通过记录最后一个赛季而走红。他在社交媒体上的意外走红使他成为全球粉丝的灵感来源。

title: Flex your football brain with our daily quizzes
summary: BBC Football offers daily quizzes including "Who Am I?", "Five in Five" and "Brainteaser" to challenge fans' football knowledge. These interactive features provide entertainment and engagement for readers.
content: Test your ball knowledge against today's Who Am I?, Five in Five and Brainteaser.

zh.title: 通过我们的每日测验展现你的足球知识
zh.summary: BBC足球频道提供每日测验，包括"我是谁？"、"五选五"和"脑筋急转弯"来挑战球迷的足球知识。这些互动功能为读者提供娱乐和互动体验。

title: Let's be brave about being in Premier League - Coventry's Lampard
summary: Frank Lampard, Coventry City manager, emphasizes the importance of playing bold and attacking football in the Premier League. The team's positive, courageous approach will define their season.
content: Frank Lampard and Tom Grennan discuss why Coventry will be playing brave football in the Premier League this season.

zh.title: 让我们勇敢面对英超——考文垂主帅兰帕德
zh.summary: 考文垂城市队主帅弗兰克·兰帕德强调了在英超联赛中踢出大胆进攻足球的重要性。球队积极勇敢的态度将定义他们的赛季表现。

title: Lampard 'somewhere in the middle' of Mourinho and Ancelotti
summary: Frank Lampard describes his managerial philosophy as a middle ground between Jose Mourinho and Carlo Ancelotti, eight years into his career. Both managers have significantly influenced his tactical and personnel approaches.
content: Eight years into his own managerial career, Coventry City boss Frank Lampard cites Jose Mourinho and Carli Ancelotti as the main influences on his style.

zh.title: 兰帕德在穆里尼奥和安切洛蒂之间"处于中间某处"
zh.summary: 弗兰克·兰帕德将他的执教哲学描述为何塞·穆里尼奥和卡洛·安切洛蒂之间的中间立场，职业生涯已进行八年。两位经理都对他的战术和人事方法产生了重大影响。
